families.title: Timing systems
families.description: Phase, stagger, easing, clocks, springs, and state sequencing as reusable temporal control signals.

families.title: Transform mechanics
families.description: Nested translation, rotation, scale, articulated linkage, and parallax assembled into kinematic systems.

families.title: Path choreography
families.description: Stroke drawing, dash transport, motion paths, topology-safe morphs, trim windows, and authored traces.

families.title: Parametric geometry
families.description: Curves generated from equations and animated by changing phase, frequency, radius, or coefficient sets.

families.title: Fields and sampling
families.description: Vector, scalar, distance, and noise fields converted into arrows, streamlines, ribbons, particles, and contours.

families.title: Simulation systems
families.description: Local rules and numerical integration for flocking, constraints, coupled springs, automata, and diffusion.

families.title: Recursive growth
families.description: Rewriting systems, accumulation, branching, aggregation, and attraction models that reveal structure over time.

families.title: Tiling and symmetry
families.description: Repeatable cells, interference, tessellation, mirrored sectors, relaxation, and quasiperiodic sampling.

families.title: Paint and compositing
families.description: Animated gradients, masks, clips, filter graphs, displacement, morphology, blur, and light sweeps.

families.title: Hybrid compositions
families.description: Reusable combinations that couple two or more temporal, geometric, simulation, and paint systems.

families.title: Multi-strata solvers
families.description: Deep numerical pipelines that expose substrate, solver, topology, geometry, rendering, diagnostics, and playback with viewport-independent state digests and canonical solver-render audits.

patterns.name: Stagger Wave
patterns.description: A grid turns one oscillator into a traveling wave by deriving delay from row and column indices.

patterns.name: Phase Lattice
patterns.description: Phase-shifted cells expose how one periodic signal produces coherent lattice motion.

patterns.name: Easing Orchestra
patterns.description: Parallel marks compare linear, ease, overshoot, stepped, and asymmetric timing profiles.

patterns.name: State Sequencer
patterns.description: A deterministic state ring derives every discrete active state from one shared keyed timeline, with no event-chain drift.

patterns.name: Loop Crossfade
patterns.description: Two complementary layers crossfade at the loop boundary so the cycle has no visible reset.

patterns.name: Spring Chain
patterns.description: Precomputed damped oscillators propagate a delayed spring response through a linked chain.

patterns.name: Nested Orbits
patterns.description: Nested local groups make each orbital frame inherit the revolution and translation of its parent.

patterns.name: Counter Rotation
patterns.description: Parent rotation moves a frame while inverse child rotation keeps labels upright.

patterns.name: Pendulum Cascade
patterns.description: Pivoted rods use distinct integer frequencies on one master clock, so their wave envelope recurs exactly at the loop boundary.

patterns.name: Gear Train
patterns.description: Pitch-circle-tangent gears derive alternating direction and exact angular-speed ratios from their tooth counts.

patterns.name: Kinematic Arm
patterns.description: Nested transforms articulate a multi-joint arm while preserving explicit pivots and link lengths.

patterns.name: Parallax Layers
patterns.description: Shared camera motion is scaled per layer to synthesize depth without 3D rendering.

patterns.name: Stroke Draw
patterns.description: A measured path is revealed from start to finish with dash offset while final geometry stays intact.

patterns.name: Dash Conveyor
patterns.description: A repeating dash pattern moves continuously to encode direction and transport.

patterns.name: Motion Follow
patterns.description: A marker follows a reusable path and automatically rotates its forward axis to the local tangent.

patterns.name: Path Morph
patterns.description: Compatible cubic paths interpolate between silhouettes without resampling artifacts.

patterns.name: Trim Window
patterns.description: Coordinated dash array and offset expose only a moving window of a longer route.

patterns.name: Handwriting Reveal
patterns.description: A pressure-like trace reveals a wider ink path while pen and lettering remain separate layers.

patterns.name: Lissajous Bloom
patterns.description: Frequency ratios and phase generate closed harmonic figures that bloom through rotation and draw.

patterns.name: Rose Curve
patterns.description: A fixed sevenfold polar harmonic is sampled deterministically, progressively revealed, and rigidly phase-rotated without changing petal topology.

patterns.name: Spirograph
patterns.description: Integer radii and pen offset generate repeatable hypotrochoid families and exact closure periods.

patterns.name: Fourier Epicycles
patterns.description: Nested relative rotations produce independent absolute harmonic vectors whose endpoint follows the sampled sum trace.

patterns.name: Superformula
patterns.description: Sampled superformula coefficients form a family between rounded, star-like, and organic silhouettes.

patterns.name: Wave Interference
patterns.description: Precomputed temporal-phase frames animate seven harmonic sums through constructive and destructive interference.

patterns.name: Vector Field
patterns.description: A sampled vector function maps local direction and magnitude to glyph orientation and length.

patterns.name: Curl Streamlines
patterns.description: Seeded particles are numerically integrated through a curl-like field to create coherent streamlines.

patterns.name: Noise Ribbons
patterns.description: Seeded periodic value-noise lattices displace parallel paths into a seamless animated ribbon field.

patterns.name: Particle Advection
patterns.description: Particles follow bounded precomputed field trajectories with deterministic phase-offset playback.

patterns.name: Distance Contours
patterns.description: Marching squares extracts nested union boundaries from a seeded nearest-site distance field.

patterns.name: Metaball Field
patterns.description: Moving source disks merge into an implicit-looking surface through blur and component-transfer thresholding.

patterns.name: Boid Flock
patterns.description: A seeded boid system records stable trajectories from three local steering behaviors.

patterns.name: Verlet Cloth
patterns.description: A point lattice advances with Verlet integration and repeated distance-constraint projection.

patterns.name: Spring Mesh
patterns.description: Coupled damped springs distribute an impulse across a compact node mesh.

patterns.name: Cellular Automaton
patterns.description: A seeded binary grid exposes several deterministic generations of a local update rule.

patterns.name: Reaction Diffusion
patterns.description: A compact Gray-Scott simulation converts evolving chemical concentration into thresholded SVG cells.

patterns.name: Diffusion Limited Aggregation
patterns.description: Seeded walkers accrete into a branching cluster and reveal their attachment order.

patterns.name: L-System Canopy
patterns.description: A deterministic grammar expands into turtle commands and reveals a recursive plant canopy by depth.

patterns.name: Phyllotaxis Bloom
patterns.description: Seeds appear in index order along a golden-angle spiral, producing dense radial packing.

patterns.name: Fractal Lightning
patterns.description: Recursive midpoint displacement and branching create a deterministic electrical growth path.

patterns.name: Space Colonization
patterns.description: Branch tips advance toward a field of attractors, splitting coverage into vein-like territories.

patterns.name: Vein Growth
patterns.description: Quadratic lateral veins and tangent-derived capillaries build a three-level leaf transport hierarchy.

patterns.name: Recursive Coral
patterns.description: A recursively scaled branching rule grows a coral silhouette with depth-specific reveal timing.

patterns.name: Truchet Flow
patterns.description: Seeded quarter-arc tiles form long accidental paths that animate as a connected flow texture.

patterns.name: Hex Wave
patterns.description: A hexagonal lattice combines radial distance and polar angle into a spiraling scale-and-color wave.

patterns.name: Voronoi Pulse
patterns.description: A compact sampled partition pulses by site order while retaining deterministic region ownership.

patterns.name: Moiré Rotation
patterns.description: Two dense line lattices rotate through complementary phases to create large-scale interference bands.

patterns.name: Kaleidoscope
patterns.description: One animated motif is reflected and rotated into a reusable dihedral symmetry system.

patterns.name: Quasicrystal
patterns.description: Several evenly rotated plane waves combine into a non-periodic-looking thresholded dot field.

patterns.name: Gradient Cycle
patterns.description: Gradient stops change color and position while geometry remains static and reusable.

patterns.name: Mask Wipe
patterns.description: A procedural mask reveals layered geometry without mutating the source artwork.

patterns.name: Clip Morph
patterns.description: A compatible clip path morphs between apertures while the clipped texture stays fixed.

patterns.name: Turbulence Warp
patterns.description: Animated turbulence frequency and displacement scale turn a stable path field into an organic warp.

patterns.name: Gooey Merge
patterns.description: Moving shapes blur and threshold into a single merging surface while a sharp overlay preserves detail.

patterns.name: Lighting Sweep
patterns.description: An animated light source sweeps across a generated relief field using SVG lighting primitives.

patterns.name: Pulse Network
patterns.driver: shared clock + dash reveals + motion tokens
patterns.signature: reveal depth → emit pulse → settle target
patterns.description: One master clock reveals DAG edges by depth, sends hidden-reset tokens forward, and settles each target after arrival.

patterns.name: Growth to Flow
patterns.signature: grow branch levels → activate complete routes
patterns.description: Recursive branch levels finish revealing before tokens traverse deterministic root-to-leaf paths during a separate operating phase.

patterns.name: Field Glyph Morph
patterns.signature: sample two fields → map direction and magnitude → interpolate
patterns.description: Two vector-field snapshots drive each glyph's orientation, opacity, and topology-compatible four-point geometry on one clock.

patterns.name: Orbit Trail System
patterns.signature: nested frame sum → endpoint trace → dash echoes
patterns.description: A three-link nested transform chain and its equation-matched closed endpoint path produce phase-shifted, decaying dash trails.

patterns.name: Tiled Wavefront
patterns.description: A breadth-first wave crosses four-neighbor tiles and bends through deterministic barrier gates instead of following DOM or Euclidean order.

patterns.name: Stateful Infographic
patterns.description: One four-state clock coordinates card emphasis, staged route reveals, forward tokens, and a masked spotlight before returning to context.

patterns.name: Alpha Persistence
patterns.driver: ranked Delaunay filtration events + Z2 persistence + discrete SMIL frames
patterns.signature: atomic α events → β₀/β₁ persistence → max-β₁ semantic static
patterns.description: A seeded Delaunay complex advances through consequential ranked simplex-event frames while synchronized boundaries and persistence intervals expose surviving components and holes; reduced motion selects the maximum-β₁ frame nearest the timeline midpoint.

patterns.name: Lower-star Join Tree
patterns.driver: seed-varied PL field + event-supplemented lower-star sweep + union-find join tree
patterns.signature: seeded scalar basis → lower-star events → audited join tree → tracked isolines
patterns.description: A meaningfully seed-varied piecewise-linear field advances through rank-sampled critical values, using lower-star sample events to fill spare frame slots so every transition changes the synchronized components, join tree, and isolines.

patterns.name: Optimal Transport
patterns.driver: entropic Sinkhorn scaling + checkpointed evidence + complete barycentric mass playback
patterns.signature: P=diag(u)Kdiag(v); render every Pᵢⱼ; P1=a, Pᵀ1=b
patterns.description: A nonnegative Sinkhorn plan carries mass between two seeded distributions while exposing a high-precision final u/kernel/v factorization, iteration-indexed scaling checkpoints with residuals, every coupling entry, and constant plan masses whose positions alone interpolate.

patterns.name: Fast Marching Front
patterns.driver: heap-ordered upwind Eikonal solve + live trial-state capture + contour extraction
patterns.description: A Fast Marching solve propagates through a seeded scalar speed field while each frame serializes the true live heap trial IDs and tentative times, live and stale heap-entry counts, accepted state, contours, and travel-time geometry.

patterns.name: Physarum Network
patterns.driver: Jones-inspired three-sensor agents + bounded nutrient guidance + trail diffusion/decay
patterns.signature: central inoculum → bounded guidance → pre/post trail fields → single-root audited backbone
patterns.description: A transparent Jones-inspired hybrid starts from one central inoculum, records distinct deposited and diffused/decayed trail fields, and extracts a thresholded predecessor backbone whose exact deterministic inoculum root is serialized, structurally audited, and visibly marked.

patterns.name: Stable Fluid
patterns.driver: seeded semi-Lagrangian advection + diffusion + audited pressure projection
patterns.technique: incompressible dye transport with projection-efficacy evidence
patterns.signature: exact source → advected pre-projection field → projected field → dye + cell-centered traces
patterns.description: A compact Stable Fluids solve renders the exact seeded force center and dye-inlet cell, preserves distinct pre/post projection evidence, requires the worst projection residual to be at most 35% of its input, transports dye with the projected field, and maps traces through finite-volume cell centers.
